extra_vocab.en: in a very careful way, without missing any details
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，thoroughly reviewed your applications 表示面試官在面試前已經仔細看完每位應徵者的資料，不會遺漏細節。thoroughly 強調做事「周全、徹底」，常放在過去分詞或動詞前面，如 thoroughly checked、thoroughly cleaned。

example.en: Please thoroughly review the contract before you sign it.
example.zh: 簽署之前，請仔細審閱合約。

example.en: Each machine is thoroughly inspected before it leaves the factory.
example.zh: 每台機器在出廠前都會經過徹底檢查。

example.en: She was thoroughly prepared for the client presentation.
example.zh: 她為客戶簡報做了周全的準備。

example.en: The kitchen must be thoroughly cleaned every evening.
example.zh: 廚房每天晚上都必須徹底清潔。

examples.en: The team discussed the budget thoroughly before making a decision.
examples.zh: 團隊在做決定之前，對預算做了徹底的討論。

examples.en: All samples were thoroughly tested in our laboratory.
examples.zh: 所有樣品都在我們的實驗室中經過徹底測試。

examples.en: We apologize and will investigate the problem thoroughly.
examples.zh: 我們深感抱歉，並將徹底調查這個問題。

confusable.diff: carefully 強調小心、謹慎地做；thoroughly 強調涵蓋所有細節、做得徹底，兩者可以同時成立。
completely 表示「完全地」，說明程度（completely finished）；thoroughly 說明做事的周全程度，常搭配檢查、閱讀、清潔等動作。

example.en: The auditor made a thorough check of the accounts.
example.zh: 審計人員對帳目做了徹底的檢查。

example.en: Please read the instructions carefully.
example.zh: 請仔細閱讀說明。

example.en: The report is completely finished and ready to send.
example.zh: 報告已經完全完成，可以寄出了。

extra_vocab.en: to use machines or computers to do a job without people
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，automated a routine process 指應徵者曾把一項重複性的例行工作改成由系統自動完成，這是面試官想了解的專案經驗。automate 的受詞通常是流程、工作或任務，常見於 IT、製造與行政自動化。

example.en: We plan to automate the invoice process next year.
example.zh: 我們計畫明年讓發票流程自動化。

example.en: This software can automate repetitive tasks in the office.
example.zh: 這套軟體可以讓辦公室裡的重複性工作自動化。

example.en: The factory decided to automate production on the main line.
example.zh: 工廠決定讓主要生產線的製造自動化。

example.en: An automated system sends a reminder to every customer.
example.zh: 自動化系統會寄提醒給每位客戶。

examples.en: I helped the finance team automate its monthly reporting.
examples.zh: 我協助財務團隊將月報告自動化。

examples.en: If we automate data entry, staff can focus on customer service.
examples.zh: 如果我們讓資料輸入自動化，員工就能專心做客戶服務。

examples.en: The call center automated its ticket assignment to shorten response times.
examples.zh: 客服中心將案件分派自動化，以縮短回應時間。

confusable.diff: automatic 是形容詞，說明東西本身會自動運作（automatic doors）；automate 是動詞，指把原本人工的流程改成自動。
computerize 指改用電腦處理；automate 指讓整個工作不需要人介入、自動完成，範圍不限於電腦。

example.en: Automation has reduced the time needed for each order.
example.zh: 自動化縮短了每筆訂單所需的時間。

example.en: The system sends an automatic reply to every email.
example.zh: 系統會對每封電子郵件發出自動回覆。

example.en: Manual data entry takes too much time.
example.zh: 人工輸入資料花太多時間。

extra_vocab.en: to tell someone what to do, officially or clearly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，unless you are instructed to do so 表示除非面試官下指示，否則請不要調整麥克風，所以是「被指示去做」的被動用法。instruct 語氣正式，常用 instruct someone to + 動詞，或被動 be instructed to + 動詞。

example.en: The manager instructed the staff to submit reports by noon.
example.zh: 經理指示員工在中午前提交報告。

example.en: Visitors are instructed to wear their badges at all times.
example.zh: 訪客被要求隨時佩戴識別證。

example.en: Please leave the equipment as it is unless instructed otherwise.
example.zh: 除非另有指示，請維持設備現狀。

example.en: A trainer will instruct staff on the new safety rules.
example.zh: 講師會向員工說明新的安全規定。

examples.en: The director has instructed us to postpone the launch until May.
examples.zh: 主管已指示我們把上市延到五月。

examples.en: New employees will be instructed on how to use the system.
examples.zh: 新進員工將接受系統操作方式的指導。

examples.en: The client instructed the lawyer to review the contract carefully.
examples.zh: 客戶指示律師仔細審閱合約。

confusable.diff: teach 指長時間教授知識或技能；instruct 指告訴對方該怎麼做，多為具體步驟或正式命令。
order 語氣更強硬，帶有命令意味；instruct 較中性正式，常用在上司對下屬或主辦單位對參與者的指示。

example.en: Please follow the instructions on the screen.
example.zh: 請依照螢幕上的指示操作。

example.en: The instructor will lead the workshop on Friday.
example.zh: 講師將在週五帶領工作坊。

example.en: All staff must follow the company's safety guidelines.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守公司的安全準則。

extra_vocab.en: a device that records or makes a voice louder
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，the microphone on the table 是用來錄下面談內容的麥克風，所以請應徵者不要自行調整。microphone 是正式說法，口語和會議中常縮寫成 mic。

example.en: Could you adjust the microphone so everyone can hear you?
example.zh: 你能調整一下麥克風，讓大家都聽得到你嗎？

example.en: The speaker used a wireless microphone during the keynote.
example.zh: 講者在主題演講中使用無線麥克風。

example.en: Please speak into the microphone when you ask a question.
example.zh: 提問時請對著麥克風說話。

example.en: Remember to turn on the microphone before the online meeting starts.
example.zh: 線上會議開始前，記得打開麥克風。

examples.en: The microphone stopped working, so we moved to a smaller room.
examples.zh: 麥克風壞了，所以我們換到比較小的房間。

examples.en: Two microphones were placed in the aisles for audience questions.
examples.zh: 走道上放了兩支麥克風，供觀眾提問使用。

examples.en: Please mute your microphone when you are not speaking.
examples.zh: 不發言時，請將麥克風靜音。

confusable.diff: speaker 是喇叭，負責把聲音播放出來；microphone 是收音裝置，負責把聲音錄進去或放大。
headset 是耳機加麥克風的組合；microphone 單指收音的裝置。

example.en: The speaker on the wall is too loud.
example.zh: 牆上的喇叭太大聲了。

example.en: Customer service staff wear a headset all day.
example.zh: 客服人員整天都戴著耳機麥克風。

example.en: Please lower the volume during the presentation.
example.zh: 簡報期間請把音量調小。

extra_vocab.en: a formal lunch, often for a meeting or special event
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，a luncheon with the team 是公司為晉級者安排的正式午餐聚會，讓應徵者與團隊交流、了解職場文化。luncheon 比 lunch 正式，常指有主題或目的的午餐活動，如商務午餐會、頒獎午宴。

example.en: The chamber of commerce hosts a business luncheon every month.
example.zh: 商會每個月都會舉辦商務午餐會。

example.en: We scheduled a luncheon meeting with the new supplier.
example.zh: 我們和新供應商安排了一場午餐會議。

example.en: The company will hold an award luncheon for top sales staff.
example.zh: 公司將為業績最佳的業務人員舉辦頒獎午宴。

example.en: Our department will host a luncheon for visiting clients.
example.zh: 我們部門將為來訪的客戶舉辦午餐會。

examples.en: You are invited to a luncheon at noon on Friday.
examples.zh: 誠摯邀請您星期五中午參加午餐會。

examples.en: Vegetarian meals will be available at the luncheon on request.
examples.zh: 午餐會可依需求提供素食餐點。

examples.en: The retirement luncheon will take place in the main dining room.
examples.zh: 退休午宴將在主餐廳舉行。

confusable.diff: lunch 是日常的午餐，口語常用；luncheon 較正式，通常指有主題、有邀請的聚餐活動。
banquet 是規模較大的正式宴會，常在晚上舉行；luncheon 專指中午舉行、規模較小的正式餐會。

example.en: Let's discuss the plan over lunch tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們明天邊吃午餐邊討論這個計畫吧。

example.en: The annual banquet will be held in December.
example.zh: 年度宴會將在十二月舉行。

example.en: The catering for the event was arranged last week.
example.zh: 這場活動的餐飲上週就已安排好。
